Source contract, provenance and limitations

Index: ((travel*8+aim)*8+phase), 16×32 cells per gait page. All cells are 96×96; feet pivot (48,84). Direction order S, SE, E, NE, N, NW, W, SW; +Y is South. Moving walk/sprint use independent travel and aim. Slide/cast/jump base lookup uses aim only.

The 800 ms eight-sample loop is a viewing aid, not gameplay timing or the distance-driven clock. No positions, authoritative foot contacts, protection, cost, cast timing or prediction state are simulated. Landing is a deliberately labeled jump→grounded storyboard. Moving-cast mode shows the documented gait-only gap, not a reconstructed missing caller.

At 1×, one source pixel equals one canvas/CSS pixel. Browser zoom, OS scaling and actual camera scale remain external. The original images are embedded losslessly and never rescaled per pose. Debug arrows and the baseline are review-only, not in the body atlas.

No runtime capture or skeleton-length proof is supplied here. Native contact perception, continuous movement, normal/reduced aerial lift, real casting and walls require the original Godot project and lead-scheduled checks.
